rows.ARS:
Light yellow Shrub.
Registration name: Meitongas
Exhibition name: Anny Duperey ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, 2006).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 2009 as 'Belle Romantica'.
rows.Bloom: Lemon-yellow. Moderate fragrance. up to 85 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Very full (41+ petals), in small clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Well-branched. Dense foliage.

Height: 31" to 43" (80 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
